name: NGC 1370 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 1370, a dusty early-type galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc1370-hubble
story: A nearby early-type galaxy wrapped in an extremely dusty torus, with dust lacing the region around its nucleus. Hubble looked here as part of a census of black holes and star clusters at the hearts of nearby galaxies.

claims.text: NGC 1370 is one of the nearby field early-type galaxies of the AMUSE-Field sample
NGC 1370 has an extremely dusty torus, with dust visible around the nucleus in the Hubble images
NGC 1370 was targeted by a Chandra/HST census of accreting black holes and nuclear star clusters in nearby spheroidal galaxies
